name: Tesseract
description: Make pictures, picture edits, effects and short videos with sound through Tesseract's official hosted remote MCP server, charged to your own Tesseract plan; every paid call takes a price ceiling. Authenticates via OAuth in your browser, no local setup or API key required.

auth.instructions: Authenticates via OAuth 2.1 in your browser with your Tesseract account (email, Google or Apple). No token or API key setup needed.
